# Legacy DOC fixture

`legacy-word97.doc` is an OLE Word 97 file generated by LibreOffice from
`legacy-word97-source.md` → hwpkit DOCX → LibreOffice `doc:MS Word 97`.
It contains Korean/Latin paragraphs and a two-column table. It is synthetic,
contains no user document data, and is independent of the new DOC decoder.

The basic browser decoder must preserve all body/cell text with an explicit
warning about formatting and table structure. The optional local LibreOffice
bridge must preserve the table structure as well.
